pre_change_archives.description: Control page and browser QA workflow exact old blobs
Roadmap and developer software backlog before closure
QA source before future-proofed state filter

changes: Developer landing separates architecture, actual technology stack, control towers, Git versions, CI, developer backlog and integration software contracts into six categories.
Added visual software-development flow: define rules, build/test, release/track; no construction project tasks or source records rendered.
Removed direct links to raw progress JSONL and normalized drawing/resource catalogue from developer directory.
Dedicated /workspace/backlog/ renders nine source-traced software tasks; status and provenance read through exact source IDs.

Excluded OPS-PEND-000004/000005/000006/000009, which are provider live execution, engineering source certification, operational reconciliation or field trade replies, preserving the original pending registry unchanged.
Developer More tools and Control Tower navigation open the dedicated software backlog, not the mixed operations pending register.
Added fail-closed developer-scope validator and source-change GitHub Actions and responsive browser regression coverage.
Roadmap Req05 and software backlog status updated atomically and checked against owning source records.
protected_domains: private Google Drive originals and provider JSONL unchanged
site-operations.html and local checklist storage unchanged
boundaries: Developer Workspace and source links are publicly readable GitHub Pages, not authenticated admin functionality.
Original mixed operations pending register remains accessible through its old route and Git history; not imported into software backlog.
Developer pointers to code/governance can include references to systems, not private source bytes or site-specific operational tasks.
Req06 provider collection and publication gates are separate and not executed in this release.
rollback: Reapply archived exact original blobs via a new traceable commit; never delete or force-reset history.
